meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 安装后 Claude 会用浏览器替你在网页上操作:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网页,并在多次脚本运行之间保留页面状态。
howto.when: 当你要求访问网站、填表、截图、抓取网页数据、测试网页或自动化浏览器流程时接管;说出 “go to [url]”、“click on”、“log into” 等话术也会触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图给我看看
say.note: 启动浏览器并保存截图

say.text: 帮我把这个注册表单填好并提交
say.note: 脚本逐步执行并返回页面状态

say.text: 抓取这个列表页里的全部内容
say.note: 可用请求拦截方式抓取批量数据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a browser for you: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data and test websites, keeping page state across script runs.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to navigate a site, fill a form, screenshot, extract web data, test a web app or automate a browser flow, e.g. saying "go to [url]", "click on" or "log into".

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot for me
say_en.note: Launches the browser and saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Fill out this signup form and submit it
say_en.note: Runs the steps and returns page state

say_en.text: Scrape everything on this listing page
say_en.note: Can intercept requests to scrape in bulk
